portInfo.description: Brindisi shares Bari Brindisi Cruise Terminal (BBCT) development planning with Bari. After describing Bari’s Pier 10 fit-out, the same BBCT Development Plans page states that the main project for Brindisi is redevelopment of the Costa Morena area through construction of a new cruise terminal. The municipal/port authority site porto.brindisi.it did not return usable content in earlier research fetches, so LOA, draught and current gangway coordinates remain unverified pending a successful primary fetch.

politics.visaRequirements: Entry and visa rules depend on nationality. Many visitors use Schengen short-stay rules, but requirements change—confirm with official government sources and your cruise line before travel.
politics.entryRequirements: Carry a valid passport (or a national ID where your cruise line and destination authorities accept it). Cruise transit formalities can differ from a normal airport entry—follow your ship’s document list.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Exit + transfer to waterfront: 30 min (estimate — replace if berth is in-town)
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: ≥6 h. Extend centro/lunch by 90 min on the short plan; keep buffer 60. Do not invent inland Lecce timing without a coach return ≥90 min before all-aboard (Lecce not sourced on BBCT page).
thingsToDo.longerCall: Lecce or Ostuni only as verified long-call coaches — not claimed from BBCT sources. Overnight: waterfront evening (editorial).
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Ask explicitly “Costa Morena or inner harbour?” before timing the monument walk.
